generate_results: public int findLargestSubstring(List<String> strings) { int result = 0; for (String str : strings) { for (int i = 0; i < str.length(); i++) { for (int j = i + 1; j <= str.length(); j++) { String sub = str.substring(i, j); String reversed = new StringBuilder(sub).reverse().toString(); if (strings.stream().anyMatch(s -> s.contains(sub) || s.contains(reversed))) { if (sub.length() > result) { result = sub.length(); } } } } } return result; }
